PROMPT

Build a single-file HTML pixel-art 3D American football game called "Gridiron Island", in the same family as my other pixel sports artifacts (cricket, baseball, tennis, futsal, volleyball): a low-resolution three.js scene on a floating island with a polished panel UI beside it. Use three.js r128 from cdnjs and Google Fonts only; vanilla JS, authored as separate source modules concatenated into one file.

LOOK
- Render into a small target (pixel-size slider, default 2 px), nearest-filter upscale. Post pass: depth-texture outlines, every colour snapped to a fixed 90-colour palette in OKLab with Bayer dithering. Orthographic isometric camera (azimuth, elevation, zoom) snapped to the pixel grid. Shadow map every frame; day, dusk and night with six floodlight towers.
- The island is a grid of 2.4 m voxel columns, terraced at the rim, banded soil and slate strata below, hanging vines, rock tails, floating chunks, a waterfall that feeds from a stream and a pond.
- The stadium: a chamfered rectangular bowl. Four lower tiers in six colours with white nosings and aisles, a glassed suite band with coloured fascia, five upper tiers, a brick wall with pilasters, windows and a cornice, a cantilevered striped canopy with pennant poles, a giant video board on one end (live score, quarter, clock, down and distance, last play) and a smaller one on the other, ribbon boards, a sponsor-board atlas around the field, a players' tunnel, stewards in hi-vis. The crowd is instanced, wears both teams' colours, some wave flags, and everyone jumps on big plays. Fireworks on touchdowns.
- Doll's-house lift: split the stadium into 8 sectors; the sectors facing the camera rise about 90 m with an eased 0.85 s motion, stop casting shadows and become hidden, so they never block the field. Toggle with a "Lift near stands" checkbox. Disabled in the ceremony, at halftime, in the island overview.
- The field is its own 1 yard = 1 unit canvas: striped grass, yard lines, hash marks, numbers whose tops point at the nearest sideline, team-coloured end zones with painted team names, a midfield logo, goalposts with ribbons, pylons, a blue line of scrimmage, a yellow first-down line, chain sticks and a down box on the far sideline. Team benches with seated players, coolers, heaters, coaches, cheerleaders at both end zones, two mascots, seven referees with signals and a thrown yellow penalty flag.
- Around the stadium: a gate arch and plaza with a fountain topped by a bronze quarterback, stalls, booths, benches, planters, a turning ferris wheel, two tailgate lots (cars, buses, tents, grills, flags), practice fields with sleds, dummies, cones and goalposts, a pond with ducks and a rowing boat, a ring road with lamps and benches, groves of pines and oaks, strolling people, a flock of birds, a blimp and a hot-air balloon (shown in the island view).

GAME
- Six fictional teams, 22 named, numbered players each, with ratings for QB, running game, receivers, offensive line, defensive line, linebackers, secondary, kicker and punter. 11 padded rigs per team: helmet, facemask, shoulder pads, back number.
- Formats: Quick 4 x 3:00, Short 4 x 5:00, Full 4 x 10:00. Coin toss, kickoffs, touchbacks and returns, downs and distance, first-down line, scoring (touchdown, extra point, two-point try, field goal, safety), quarters with end changes, halftime, sudden-death overtime, timeouts, two-minute behaviour (hurry-up, spikes, kneels, going for it).
- Every snap is a computed play, pre-simulated at 20 Hz and played back: the line blocks and rushes, receivers run routes (slant, hitch, out, dig, post, go, seam, flat, screen), the ball flies on an arc, defenders cover (man or zone) and pursue, tackles and piles, sacks, interceptions and pick-sixes, fumbles and recoveries, penalties (false start, offside, holding, pass interference) with a flag.
- Offensive calls: inside run, outside run, QB sneak, quick, short, medium and deep pass, screen, punt, field goal, kneel, spike. Defensive calls: balanced, run stop, blitz, zone, prevent. Outcomes depend on both teams' ratings, the call against the call, the surface, weather and wind.
- I coach one team (the AI runs the other): a play-style selector, buttons for every call with a "coach suggestion" badge, a "Call every play myself" mode that waits for my click (including extra point or two), a timeout button.
- Surfaces: grass, turf, mud, snow (each repainted, each changing speed, ball security, passing and kicking). Weather: clear, windy, rain (falling streaks). Gauges and a hint for each.
- Cameras: TV side view that follows the ball, behind the offense, sky, whole island. Speed 1/2x to 4x, pause, skip ceremony, auto-next game, synthesised Web Audio sound, outlines/dither/raw 3D toggles, light and dark themes, mobile layout with drag-to-turn and pinch-to-zoom.
- Panel: box score by quarter, team stats, play-by-play feed, scoreboard bug with timeouts.

QUALITY BAR
- No console errors; run simulated games headlessly on every surface and weather, both coach sides, all three formats, and check scoring balance (a few touchdowns and field goals per game, realistic yards per play).
- Merge static meshes that share a material, instance crowds and trees; check screenshots at several angles, at night, in snow and mud, and at phone width.

VIDEO PROMPT — 30 seconds. 16:9 landscape. Ultra-realistic cinematic Korean historical fantasy drama, photoreal faces and skin texture, realistic fabric and hair physics, 35-50mm anamorphic look, cool blue-grey winter grade with icy cyan highlights and controlled contrast, soft overcast daylight with drifting mist and snow particles; glowing blue magic is the only saturated color. Camera: grounded, low near the ice, slow and composed in the dialogue, then fast handheld-feel tracking and rapid impact cuts with brief slow motion in the fight. Pacing: calm 10-second standoff, a sudden explosive 13-second fight, a held final pose, cut to black.

CHARACTERS:
- SEOHA, the assassin: Korean woman, mid-20s, pale porcelain skin, large dark almond eyes, soft oval face, natural rosy lips. Very long dark wine-red / burgundy hair pulled into a high ponytail that hangs to her waist, a few loose strands framing her face, a small silver hair ornament at the crown of the ponytail. Small pearl-drop earrings. Black Joseon-style layered assassin robe with a crossed collar and faint dark-silver embroidered patterns on the chest and sleeves, black sash belt, long black skirt panels that flare when she moves, black leather boots, black lacquered scabbard. Long straight single-edged steel sword. Calm, faintly amused, cold expression in every shot.
- THE ROYAL MAGES (6): Korean men 30-50, black hair in topknots, some with short beards, heavy dark navy-black layered robes and cloaks that blow in the wind. Blue magical energy glows as bright cyan orbs around their hands. In the fight some carry long dark staffs and short swords.

LOCATION: a vast frozen lake, glassy blue-grey ice with thin white crack lines and patches of snow; dark pine forests on snowy hills along the shore, snow-covered mountains behind; thick winter mist blowing low across the ice. No buildings, no modern objects.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:04.6) — The circle. Wide establishing shot from just above ice level, almost locked-off with a very slow drift forward. Seoha stands small in the middle distance at the center of the lake, back half-turned to camera, red ponytail visible. Six mages stand spread in a loose ring around her: one large cloaked mage in the right-center foreground with his back to camera, one at the far left foreground, others scattered behind her. MUST SHOW: bright cyan-blue energy glowing around several mages' hands. The mage at the right edge steps forward and raises one hand as blue energy gathers around his fingers. Mist streams across the ice. Male mage, low and threatening: "네가 바로 서하인가?" (00:00.5-00:02.8), then "그림자 암살자?" (00:03.0-00:04.4).

SHOT 2 (00:04.6-00:10.4) — The name. Medium close-up of Seoha, framed left of center, shot over the blurred dark shoulder of a mage in the right foreground; background a soft out-of-focus snowy pine shore. Very slow push-in. She has turned her head toward the mage (camera right) and looks at him with a cool, confident gaze, chin slightly lowered; strands of red hair lift in the wind, pearl earrings sway. She speaks quietly with a mocking half-smile: "내가 가는 곳마다 목이 땅에 떨어지지." (00:04.8-00:07.8) "아름다운 이름이지 않나?" (00:08.0-00:09.3) and, smiling wider, "서하." (00:09.5-00:10.3).

SHOT 3 (00:10.4-00:10.9) — The strike. Close-up of her face: a mage's open hand thrusts into the foreground and a blinding blast of cyan-blue energy floods the frame, lighting her face blue. She doesn't blink.

SHOT 4 (00:10.9-00:11.9) — The draw. Medium-wide at ice level, snowy forest behind, mages on both sides with glowing hands. She draws her sword in one motion and spins as the mage on the right fires a ball of blue energy at her; robe and ponytail whip around.

SHOT 5 (00:11.9-00:14.8) — The slide. Low dynamic tracking shot alongside her. The blue blast explodes behind her in a cloud of blue mist, ice shards and snow; she bursts out of it sliding low across the ice on one bent knee, sword held out behind her, skirt panels fanning, leaving a scratched trail. She comes up into a low ready stance facing camera, sword angled down. MUST SHOW: two defeated mages lying flat on the ice behind her.

SHOT 6 (00:14.8-00:15.9) — Ambush. Low angle, a mage lunges in from the right foreground with a short sword; she drops into a deep crouch under the strike.

SHOT 7 (00:15.9-00:17.4) — Whirlwind. Very fast cuts every 0.2-0.3 seconds, close and blurred: she spins between two attackers, her long red ponytail whipping across the lens, black sleeves and cloaks flying, a staff swinging over her head as she ducks beneath it.

SHOT 8 (00:17.4-00:18.4) — Profile. Brief slow motion: close side profile of her face as she spins past camera, eyes locked on the next attacker, hair swinging in a wide arc; then from behind her as she turns into a mage raising his staff.

SHOT 9 (00:18.4-00:19.6) — The block. Medium two-shot, fast tracking: she sweeps her sword horizontally, then a mage swings a long dark staff down at her and she blocks it overhead with her blade; the impact jolts both.

SHOT 10 (00:19.6-00:20.2) — Disarm. Quick medium shot: with a twist of the blade she strips the staff from his hands; it spins away across the ice and he stumbles back.

SHOT 11 (00:20.2-00:22.6) — The ice wave. Medium-wide, snowy pine shore behind. She pivots and drives the sword point down into the ice. MUST SHOW: a crackling wave of bright cyan-blue energy veins rips across the ice surface from the blade, glowing cracks spreading outward; it hurls the nearest mage backward off his feet while two downed mages lie in the glowing blue light.

SHOT 12 (00:22.6-00:25.4) — Last stand. Wide shot from low in front of her, snowy mountains and pine hills behind. Seoha stands center, three-quarter to camera, sword lowered at her right side. Behind her five mages crouch in a wide arc, hands raised, gathering energy; MUST SHOW: bright cyan orbs of light growing in every mage's hands, and from 00:23.5 a blue glow spreading along her blade, crackling like frost. At 00:24.8 she springs forward toward camera with the glowing sword sweeping low.

SHOT 13 (00:25.4-00:29.6) — Aftermath. Same wide framing. MUST SHOW: a huge burst of blue light, snow and ice fog erupts behind her as the combined attack shatters, filling the background; the mages are flung through the air. The mist rolls away to reveal every mage lying scattered and motionless on the ice. Slow push-in to a medium-wide on Seoha standing alone in the foreground, sword held low and horizontal at her side, red ponytail and skirt panels blowing; she slowly turns her head toward camera with a cold, quiet look, not quite into the lens.

SHOT 14 (00:29.6-00:30.1) — Hard cut to black.

SOUND: no music under the dialogue in shots 1-2, only howling wind, creaking ice and the low hum of magic; a deep, tense cinematic score with taiko-style drums kicks in at shot 3 and drives the fight. Effects: an energy blast roar, a metallic sword draw, the hiss of her slide on ice, whooshing cloth, staff-and-blade clangs, an ice crack and crackling electric energy surge, a massive blue explosion boom, then wind and settling ice crystals over the final shot and a single low drum hit on the cut to black. Dialogue in Korean with accurate lip-sync.

prompt

FROZEN BLADES — THE LAST BREATH
EXTREME CINEMATIC SWORD FIGHT — 30 SECONDS
GENRE: Ultra-intense samurai action thriller, hyper-realistic live-action, high-budget martial arts cinematography.
FORMAT: 30 seconds, 16:9 widescreen, 4K, 30fps delivery, realistic high-speed choreography, aggressive handheld camera, explosive sound design, cold blue cinematic grading, violent snowstorm.
ABSOLUTE PRIORITY: THIS IS NOT A GRACEFUL SWORD DANCE. THIS IS A FEROCIOUS, DESPERATE, LIFE-OR-DEATH DUEL. Every second must contain threatening attacks, emergency defenses, brutal counterstrikes, dangerous movement, or overwhelming physical impact. no one falls down.
The action should feel frighteningly fast, precise, unpredictable, and powerful. Both warriors fight with terrifying skill. Neither gives the other a moment to recover.
CHARACTERS — STRICT IDENTITY LOCK
BLACK WOLF: <<<image_1>>> A fierce 27-year-old Japanese female samurai with piercing dark eyes, long black hair tied in a high ponytail, battle-worn matte-black samurai armor, a torn black scarf, heavy black boots, and a polished long steel katana with a black handle. Explosive, relentless, physically aggressive, attacking with terrifying speed.
WHITE PHANTOM: <<<image_2>>> A striking 26-year-old Japanese female samurai with blue eyes, pastel pink braided hair, elegant but battle-worn white-and-silver samurai armor, white leather boots, and a polished long silver katana with an ivory handle. Ruthlessly precise, incredibly agile, fearless, and devastatingly fast at close range.
Both women are highly trained professional swordswomen. Their expressions are furious, focused, and emotionally intense. Visible exertion, rapid breathing, clenched jaws, fierce eye contact, snow on their faces, and realistic physical exhaustion.
LOCATION: A narrow ancient stone bridge covered in ice and deep snow, suspended between enormous Himalayan mountain cliffs above a terrifying bottomless-looking abyss. Broken stone railings, frozen cracks, howling winds, heavy snowfall, and enormous mountains barely visible through the blizzard.
00:00–00:03 — THE SHOCK HOOK
START WITH AN EXPLOSION OF ACTION. NO INTRODUCTION.
FIRST FRAME: EXTREME CLOSE-UP.
TWO KATANAS COLLIDE VIOLENTLY DIRECTLY IN FRONT OF THE CAMERA.
A DEAFENING METALLIC CRASH.
A FLASH OF SPARKS.
The camera violently pulls backward, revealing both female warriors already engaged in a terrifying close-range sword fight.
BLACK WOLF launches three explosive sword attacks in less than two seconds.
WHITE PHANTOM barely survives, blocking the first strike, ducking beneath the second, and catching the third blade inches from her face.
Their faces are almost touching.
BLACK WOLF suddenly drives her armored shoulder into WHITE PHANTOM.
WHITE PHANTOM crashes backward into a frozen stone pillar.
THE PILLAR CRACKS.
Snow erupts from the impact.
Before she can fully recover, BLACK WOLF is already attacking again.
CAMERA: Extreme macro blade collision → violent whip-pullback → close-range handheld tracking → aggressive side angle.
SOUND: Deafening metallic impact, deep sub-bass hit, immediate rapid percussion. No gentle musical introduction.
00:03–00:07 — THE UNSTOPPABLE ASSAULT
BLACK WOLF unleashes a furious sequence of seven tightly connected attacks.
Overhead slash.
Diagonal cut.
Reverse horizontal strike.
Rapid thrust.
Spinning backhand slash.
Low sweeping strike.
Explosive downward attack.
WHITE PHANTOM defends desperately, her blade intercepting each attack at the last possible instant.
Every collision feels heavy and dangerous.
Steel rings violently.
Sparks flash.
Their boots skid across the ice.
BLACK WOLF suddenly kicks WHITE PHANTOM hard in the chest armor.
WHITE PHANTOM slides backward across the bridge, her boots carving deep grooves into the snow.
She immediately drops low, launches herself forward, and attacks BLACK WOLF's exposed side.
BLACK WOLF twists and narrowly blocks.
NO BREAK BETWEEN ATTACKS.
Camera races alongside the fighters, keeping their full bodies visible during the fastest exchanges.
00:07–00:11 — SAVAGE CLOSE-RANGE COMBAT
WHITE PHANTOM suddenly becomes the aggressor.
She attacks with five devastating sword combinations while advancing.
BLACK WOLF retreats under the pressure.
WHITE PHANTOM strikes high.
BLACK WOLF blocks.
WHITE PHANTOM instantly redirects low.
BLACK WOLF jumps over the blade.
WHITE PHANTOM pivots and attacks again before BLACK WOLF fully lands.
BLACK WOLF catches the strike with her katana, forcing both swords into a grinding blade lock.
Their faces are inches apart.
Their boots slide dangerously toward the broken bridge edge.
BLACK WOLF suddenly breaks the lock, delivers a powerful armored elbow strike to WHITE PHANTOM's shoulder, and spins into another katana attack.
WHITE PHANTOM drops backward into a low sliding dodge.
THE BLADE PASSES JUST ABOVE HER FACE.
She sweeps her leg against BLACK WOLF's supporting ankle.
BLACK WOLF stumbles but recovers instantly.
CAMERA: Low-angle tracking at boot level, aggressive push-in, rapid whip-pan following the katana, extreme close-up of their furious eyes.
00:11–00:15 — THE BRIDGE STARTS BREAKING
The battle becomes even more dangerous.
BLACK WOLF leaps forward with a brutal descending sword strike.
WHITE PHANTOM blocks overhead.
The force drives her backward onto one knee.
The ice beneath her fractures.
BLACK WOLF attacks again.
WHITE PHANTOM rolls sideways, narrowly escaping.
The katana strikes the stone railing.
A section of ancient frost-damaged masonry breaks away and falls into the abyss.
WHITE PHANTOM springs upward and delivers a fast spinning kick into BLACK WOLF's armored torso.
BLACK WOLF staggers into the remaining railing.
The stone collapses behind her.
She barely regains her footing.
WHITE PHANTOM immediately attacks with a rapid three-strike combination.
BLACK WOLF blocks while stepping dangerously close to the edge.
CAMERA: Fast lateral tracking, overhead shot revealing the enormous drop, immediate return to close-range combat.
SOUND: Cracking ice, collapsing stone, howling wind, pounding percussion, relentless metallic strikes.
00:15–00:19 — THE MOST VIOLENT EXCHANGE
BOTH WARRIORS ATTACK SIMULTANEOUSLY.
An incredibly fast, continuous, precisely choreographed sword exchange.
Their blades collide repeatedly.
High strike. Block. Counterstrike. Duck. Reverse slash. Parry. Kick. Pivot. Overhead attack. Emergency defense.
Neither warrior retreats willingly.
BLACK WOLF delivers a powerful front kick.
WHITE PHANTOM catches herself on one hand, swings her legs around, and rises into an immediate counterattack.
BLACK WOLF narrowly avoids the blade.
WHITE PHANTOM jumps onto a surviving stone parapet and launches herself sideways.
She rotates through the air, bringing her katana down toward BLACK WOLF.
BLACK WOLF raises her sword.
A THUNDEROUS MID-AIR BLADE COLLISION.
The impact throws snow from the nearby stonework.
WHITE PHANTOM lands, slides, and immediately continues attacking.
CAMERA: Rapid tracking with brief controlled handheld shake at each major impact. No excessive slow motion. Keep the violence of the movement at full speed.
00:19–00:23 — PURE CHAOS
THE BLIZZARD REACHES MAXIMUM INTENSITY.
Both warriors fight through near-whiteout conditions.
BLACK WOLF charges through a wall of swirling snow.
Her katana suddenly emerges from the storm.
WHITE PHANTOM barely blocks the surprise attack.
The collision knocks both swords sideways.
They immediately close the distance.
Shoulder collision.
Armored forearm strike.
Rapid katana counter.
Low dodge.
Spinning slash.
A powerful kick sends BLACK WOLF skidding backward.
She plants her sword tip against the stone momentarily to stop her slide, then immediately recovers her fighting grip.
WHITE PHANTOM rushes forward.
Their blades collide four times in a frantic, extremely fast combination.
The camera follows the fight in a continuous, breathless tracking shot.
The entire bridge trembles as ice and loose stone break away beneath their feet.
00:23–00:27 — THE GOOSEBUMPS MOMENT
SUDDENLY, THE MUSIC CUTS OUT FOR HALF A SECOND.
Only the terrifying sound of the wind remains.
EXTREME CLOSE-UP:
BLACK WOLF'S EYES.
CUT TO:
WHITE PHANTOM'S EYES.
Both women launch forward at exactly the same instant.
THE MUSIC RETURNS WITH A MASSIVE ORCHESTRAL IMPACT.
They sprint across the cracking bridge at maximum speed.
BLACK WOLF jumps from a raised stone block.
WHITE PHANTOM launches from the opposite side.
Both warriors rise into the air, katanas raised for their strongest attacks.
The camera sweeps underneath them, revealing the endless abyss and clouds below.
THEIR SWORDS COLLIDE IN MID-AIR.
AN EAR-SPLITTING METALLIC IMPACT.
For just 0.4 seconds, the image shifts into spectacular high-frame-rate slow motion.
Frozen particles erupt from their armor.
A nearby accumulation of powder snow bursts into a magnificent white cloud from the force of their landing and the collapsing stonework.
Their faces show absolute determination.
The camera captures the exact moment of the blades crossing.
INSTANTLY RETURN TO FULL SPEED.
00:27–00:30 — THE FINAL SHOCK
Both warriors crash down onto the frozen bridge.
The impact sends loose snow exploding outward.
The stone beneath them fractures.
WITHOUT PAUSING, THEY CONTINUE FIGHTING.
BLACK WOLF launches one final furious overhead slash.
WHITE PHANTOM ducks beneath it and spins around her opponent.
Their swords flash past each other in one breathtaking, precisely timed crossing attack.
A SHARP METALLIC RING.
Both warriors slide past one another, landing back-to-back several meters apart.
A huge crack races across the bridge between them.
The central section of the bridge suddenly begins collapsing into the clouds.
Both warriors leap toward opposite surviving sections of stone.

An enormous wide shot reveals both women landing on opposite sides of the broken bridge, facing each other across a widening abyss.

Their katanas remain raised.

Premium Hollywood martial arts action-film aesthetic.
35mm anamorphic cinematic lens characteristics.
Ultra-realistic 4K textures and natural human anatomy.
Extremely fast but readable choreography.
Aggressive camera movement without losing spatial continuity.
Close-range blade collisions.
Low-angle combat tracking.
Rapid side-to-side camera movement.
Overhead shots emphasizing danger.
Sudden crash zooms during threatening attacks.
Brief speed ramps only during major impacts.
Natural motion blur, cold blue-gray color grading, dramatic silver highlights.
Realistic snow particles, physically believable ice fractures, authentic fabric physics, and heavy armor movement.
MUSIC AND SOUND
MUSIC: Dark, terrifying, high-energy cinematic action score. Massive taiko drums, aggressive orchestral percussion, rapid string ostinatos, deep distorted bass pulses, pounding low brass, and a relentless accelerating rhythm.
SFX: Extremely loud metallic katana collisions, sharp sword swishes, heavy armored kicks, forceful shoulder impacts, boots scraping ice, cracking stone, breaking railings, explosive snow movement, fierce breathing, and violent mountain winds.
Use a brief musical dropout before the final aerial collision to make the returning impact feel overwhelming.
NON-NEGOTIABLE RULES
95% continuous aggressive combat.
First frame must contain a violent sword collision.
No standing around, posing, or walking.
Every defensive movement must immediately lead into another attack.
Both warriors must attack with equal intensity.
No slow, decorative sword dancing.
No repeated identical sword animations.
No excessive floating or weightless flips.
No long slow-motion sequences.
Sword clashes must feel heavy, sharp, and dangerous.
Camera must follow the action without hiding the choreography.
Characters must remain consistent in every frame.
No blood or gore required; communicate danger through physical force, speed, and near misses.
The final five seconds must feel more intense than the opening.
The ending must be sudden, spectacular, and unforgettable.
NEGATIVE PROMPT: Slow fighting, weak impacts, graceful dancing, random sword waving, passive opponents, long pauses, excessive posing, artificial movements, robotic combat, unrealistic anatomy, floating bodies, weightless swords, missing blades, duplicated limbs, changing faces, excessive camera shake, excessive slow motion, cartoon physics, artificial snow, low-detail environments, subtitles, text, logos, watermarks.
FINAL CREATIVE GOAL: Make viewers feel that they have witnessed 30 seconds of the most terrifyingly fast, technically brilliant, and visually spectacular female samurai sword combat imaginable. Every impact must feel dangerous. Every dodge must feel like a near-death escape. Every second must escalate the tension. The final sword collision and bridge collapse must deliver a powerful cinematic adrenaline rush.
